reason: I don't swallow pills, I only buy gummies or drinks, and this is 2 capsules every single day. The lab report and the foil sachets are nice, but they don't fix the part I hate.
objection: Two capsules a day, every day. I'd end up with a box in the cupboard I never finish, and the guarantee only works if I take all 30 sachets.
would_change_my_mind: A gummy or powder drink version with the same tested magnesium bisglycinate dose.
